entries.text: Director Clavell?
entries.label: team_0040_select_01

entries.text: Clive?
entries.label: team_0040_select_02

entries.text: Like I said before, the name’s Clive. Please don’t\nforget it.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_02

entries.text: Yup, that’s me! Clive, the normal academy\nstudent.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_03

entries.text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Anyway, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]... I owe\nyou\r\none.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_04

entries.text: Thanks to you, I’ve been accepted into\nOperation Starfall.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_05

entries.text: Why did you join?
entries.label: team_0040_select_03

entries.text: What’s your endgame?
entries.label: team_0040_select_04

entries.text: I need answers, that’s all.\c\nHow do I resolve this situation with Team Star...\nand what’s causing its members’ odd behavior?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_06

entries.text: What situation?
entries.label: team_0040_select_05

entries.text: Odd behavior?
entries.label: team_0040_select_06

entries.text: Team Star is the subject of more than a few nasty\nrumors swirling around the academy, you know.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_07

entries.text:
Some say their bullying has caused a worrying
number of students to drop out of school...\c
Others say they’re holed up in their bases,
plotting to cause trouble for the academy.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_08

entries.text: But these are rumors. The matter I am directly\nconfronted with is something else...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_09

entries.text: I’m talking about Team Star’s persistent truancy.\nThey’ve all been skipping class for a while now...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_10

entries.text: Five of them in particular—the so-called “bosses”\nof Team Star—haven’t so much as set foot inside\r\na classroom for over a year.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_11

entries.text: And it seems the team’s rank and file have\nrecently started stirring up mischief as well.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_12

entries.text: That’s why I took it upon myself to issue a direct\norder to Team Star to disband.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_13

entries.text: I informed them that should they refuse, I would\nhave no choice but to expel all students affiliated\r\nwith their team...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_14

entries.text: But I’m afraid there’s been no response. And the\ndeadline I set for them to make their choice\r\nbetween dissolution or expulsion is nigh upon us.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_15

entries.text: So you see, when I overheard you talking on the\nphone to Cassiopeia, it couldn’t have come at\r\na more crucial time...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_16

entries.text: Ro-to-to-to-to... ♪
entries.label: team_0040_system_01

entries.text: It’s Cassiopeia. Can you hear me?[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0040_cassiopeia_01

entries.text:
*whisper whisper*
Another time, then...\c
*whisper whisper*
Be careful...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]
entries.label: team_0040_nelke_18

entries.text: I see you’re coming up to one of Team Star’s\nbases. Was there...someone with you just now?[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0040_cassiopeia_02

entries.text: Nobody
entries.label: team_0040_select_07

entries.text: It’s just me
entries.label: team_0040_select_08

entries.text: Well...be warned that Team Star will have its\nguard up after losing one boss to you already.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0040_cassiopeia_03

entries.text: This base won’t go down as easily as the last one.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0040_cassiopeia_04

entries.text: Proceed with extreme caution. I’ll be in touch.[VAR 0x0114(0009)]
entries.label: team_0040_cassiopeia_05
